title: Song Hye-kyo and GONG YOO Chase Glittering Dreams in 'Tantara', Premiering December 11
summary: December 11, exclusively on Netflix. The series brings together acclaimed writer Noh Hee-gyoung (Our Blues, It’s Okay, That’s Love) and director Lee Yoon-jung
body_markdown:
###


Coming December 11, only on Netflix.


The series brings together acclaimed writer Noh Hee-gyoung (


[Our Blues](https://www.netflix.com/watch/81568842?source=35) , It’s Okay, That’s Love


) and director Lee Yoon-jung (


The 1st Shop of Coffee Prince


) with a star-studded cast including Song Hye-kyo, GONG YOO, Kim Seol-hyun, and Cha Seung-won.


Set against the gritty and intense backdrop of the Korean entertainment industry from the 1960s to the 1980s, the series follows individuals who, despite having little, dreamed of glittering success and gave their all to achieve it.


The story revolves around Min-ja (Song Hye-kyo), who enters the music business after surviving an impoverished childhood in which she took on any job to endure. Beside her stands Dong-gu (GONG YOO), her childhood friend who fights alongside her to protect her dreams. They are joined by Min-hui (Kim Seol-Hyun), a bold talent with a captivating voice who becomes their very first artist, and Seok Gil-yeo (Cha Seung won), the era’s top hitmaker, capable of turning rookies into megastars. Rising from the bottom of society through severe hardships, they pursue their ambitions with passion, set to resonate deeply with viewers around the world.


The accompanying date announcement poster unfolds the characters’ lives in a vibrant panorama around a turntable. From Min-ja and Dong-gu’s rise from nightclub staff to rookie talent managers, to rising star Min-hui singing with passion alongside maestro Seok Gil-yeo on the saxophone, the artwork teases a rich, music-driven saga of resilience and ambition.


Tantara


premieres December 11, only on Netflix.
